readerJob: Decide whether a Netherlands-based creator should pay for iPhone Duo to gain a foldable review and two-app workspace, and identify when its price, weight, camera set or untested workflow value makes a conventional phone or tablet the better purchase.
decision: Do not issue a buying recommendation yet. Apple Netherlands establishes an orderable A3720 family and exact 256 GB entry price, but manufacturer specifications and launch demonstrations do not establish creator-workflow speed, hinge durability, thermal behaviour, battery life under capture-and-publish work, or whether the foldable canvas replaces another carried device.
wrongPurchaseConditions: The buyer expects the 7.6-inch inner display alone to replace a tablet or laptop without testing the exact editing, review, file-transfer and publishing workflow.
The buyer needs an ultrawide or dedicated telephoto camera rather than the documented 48 MP main camera and 2x crop option.
The buyer treats Apple's up-to battery figures as independent capture, editing or hotspot endurance.
The buyer needs a physical SIM slot; the Dutch A3720 specification is dual eSIM only.
The buyer is uncomfortable carrying a 254 gram phone or an 11.3 mm folded device.
The buyer assumes every app shown or named by Apple already has a complete foldable layout in the Netherlands.
The buyer cannot justify the dated EUR 2,339 entry price against a conventional iPhone plus an existing tablet or monitor.
evidenceLevel: official manufacturer launch, Dutch specification and Dutch store observations; no hands-on testing

claims.text: Apple dates the iPhone Duo announcement October 15, 2026 and says pre-orders began October 16.
claims.allowedWording: Attribute the date and availability wording to Apple.

claims.text: Apple describes iPhone Duo as its first foldable iPhone, powered by A20 Pro and iOS 27.
claims.allowedWording: Keep Apple attribution and do not convert the positioning into an independent verdict.

claims.text: Apple says the inner display is 50 percent larger than iPhone 18 Pro Max and positions the device for content, gaming and multitasking.
claims.allowedWording: Present as Apple's positioning, not measured creator value.

claims.text: Apple says iOS 27 adds Split View for two apps side by side on iPhone Duo.
claims.allowedWording: Name the feature without claiming it improves a workflow that has not been tested.

claims.text: Apple names Word, Outlook, Zoom, Slack, Fantastical, Notewise, Things and Bear among applications using or preparing layouts for the larger display, with some updates described as still rolling out.
claims.allowedWording: Verify the exact app version and Dutch availability before calling a layout available.

claims.text: Apple Netherlands specifies a 7.6-inch 1878 x 2670 inner display and a 5.4-inch 1398 x 2034 outer display, both with adaptive refresh up to 120 Hz.
claims.allowedWording: Use for model A3720 only and preserve manufacturer attribution.

claims.text: Apple Netherlands lists 254 grams, 5.2 mm depth when open and 11.3 mm depth when folded.
claims.allowedWording: Treat comfort and pocketability as untested until firsthand evidence exists.

claims.text: Apple Netherlands lists a 48 MP Fusion main camera and a 12 MP 2x optical-quality crop option; the checked specification does not list an ultrawide or dedicated telephoto camera.
claims.allowedWording: Describe the documented camera set without asserting image quality.

claims.text: Apple Netherlands specifies USB-C with DisplayPort and USB 3 transfer up to 10 Gb/s.
claims.allowedWording: Do not infer accessory compatibility or sustained transfer performance.

claims.text: Apple Netherlands identifies model A3720 as dual eSIM and not compatible with physical SIM cards.
claims.allowedWording: Verify the reader's carrier eSIM support separately.

claims.text: Apple Netherlands lists orderable 256 GB, 512 GB, 1 TB and 2 TB iPhone Duo configurations in Sterrenwit and Nachthemel.
On October 26, 2026, Apple Netherlands displayed EUR 2,339 including VAT for the 256 GB configuration.
claims.allowedWording: Use only with the date, configuration, currency and manufacturer-store context; otherwise omit.

claims.text: Apple's October 23 photos page offers downloadable media but the checked workflow did not establish a commercial republication licence for either site.
claims.allowedWording: Keep media quarantined until a per-asset permission receipt is recorded; download availability alone is not approval.

rows.qualification: Split View and named app layouts are manufacturer evidence; complete workflow remains untested.
The documented camera set lacks an ultrawide or dedicated telephoto; image quality is untested.
Requires a complete carry, edit, review, export and publish test against a conventional phone plus tablet.
The dated EUR 2,339 price is verified, but incremental workflow value and durability are not.

uncertainty: Independent hinge-cycle, drop, scratch, repairability and long-term display evidence for the exact A3720 generation.
Battery, thermal and sustained-performance behaviour during capture, editing, hotspot, upload and two-app work.
Exact Dutch app versions and foldable layouts for the reader's workflow.
Camera quality, stabilization, audio and transfer performance compared with a conventional flagship phone.
Whether the larger canvas removes a second device from the reader's actual carry.
Written commercial reuse permission for an exact Apple product image or an original exact-device photograph.
